state.goal: Complete already specified exactly-one-compatible enclosing-record form binding for actual PromptLab nested Entry.create and Note.create, preserving canonical parent semantics and protected source forms without creating new source syntax or changing create API requirements.
verified_facts: DESIGN.md specifies enclosing record chain retention and automatic record-parameter binding when exactly one compatible record exists. Compiler previously omitted implicit arguments; scoped correction now emits actual observed parent record snapshot arguments.

Real installed form preparer now refuses these emitted args as unsupported: packages/interfaces/src/http/forms.ts and form-binding.ts require declared ref.versioned===true. Their existing bound payload is exactly {id,version}, canonical integer string version, authenticated host-key MAC over session/actor/team/app/operation/schema/source revision/operation nonce and bound refs/editable allowlist.

CRUD create parent descriptor intentionally sets require_version:false (compiler js.rs). Parent is linkage, not an update target. Existing canonical native API admits parent.id; changing require_version globally would tighten existing API. State create consumes canonical parent identity and revalidates current parent/read authority and final commit scope. Its internal CRUD parent rejects a version property.

Existing incoming API ref checker allows optional version when not required. Existing Cloudflare source validation consumes/translates incoming parent {id,version} to canonical parent linkage. Native direct parent creation using observed id+version succeeds. Thus the internal State shape need not change.

Current source-form adapter already copies id/version from an actual evaluated record argument. Sealing is only host-controlled render preparation, not a request ability to choose bound refs. Signature/inventory/current identity/source/expiry/nonce/editable-disjointness checks remain and State independently rechecks authority. No new token carrier is needed to carry the already supported observed pair.

Scenario model record parameters currently already require versions; behavior there remains unchanged. Source omitted fields still require bound/defaulted/optional inputs; zero/multiple matching implicit records must not silently choose one.
state.acceptance: Actual compiler-emitted Entry/Note parent-bound forms prepare, preserve protected selected parent identity, and submit through canonical invocation. Forged/changed parent token inputs refuse. Existing unbound API parent.id and scenario versioned refs retain behavior; no weakening State current authority, signatures, omission checks, or public API version requirements.
state.comparison: Assess these viable bounded approaches against the SAME actual required outcome, preserving authority and validation order. Advice is not source authority. Prefer simple existing mechanisms; broader inferred capabilities are not acceptance requirements.

implementation.instructions: For the same required nested-create workflow, which adapter approach has the strongest correctness and simplicity tradeoff without tightening the ordinary create API or inventing new source authority?

criteria.observed_singular_refs: Allow existing protected form binding for any declared singular ref, including unversioned declarations, while still requiring the actual bound value to contain the existing exact observed {id,version} pair and passing unchanged checkBoundArguments. Remove only versioned:true admission restriction in adapter and token selection; keep full version pair, all signature checks, source/current authorization and canonical parent translation. Uniform reference handling and no token representation change; must verify optional-version parent compatibility and reject malformed snapshots.
criteria.create_parent_only: Admit the same existing observed {id,version} pair only for the demonstrated derived.kind=create, input.name=parent unversioned exception; retain versioned:true restriction for other refs. Same authority and token representation; smallest behavioral expansion, but a special case in two existing adapters that could leave other declared source record bindings unsupported. No claim to close unassigned profiles.
criteria.declared_identity_projection: For unversioned declared refs, project the evaluated record snapshot to its declared {id} shape and extend protected form token validation/encoding to accept this closed id-only alternative; preserve {id,version} for version-required refs. Same current State checks and hidden/immutable parent identity, no global API tightening. Aligns token shape with declared requirement but introduces a second token payload shape and updates restore/comparison identity handling.
